name: Chime Card
catalogRoleReason: The only card in the catalog with no credit check to apply.

conditions.text: To get the Chime Card you must open a Chime Checking Account, and your money moves through that account.

Cash back only works if your paycheck or other qualifying direct deposits go into Chime (at least $200 in one deposit or $400 in 34 days for 2%, $3,000 for 5%); without that you earn nothing. Cash back counts on up to $1,500 of purchases a month.
There is no real credit line: you can only spend the money you move in, and the limit starts at $0.
Chime does not report how much of a limit you use, so this card builds payment history but does not help the utilization part of your score.
